mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Corsair Captain: "When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact
# with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.") Other Pirates you control get
# +1/+1."
# Enters: the compiler's "When this creature enters" with the compiler's one Treasure TokenSpec
# (M21 Gadrak's verified B2a-gadrak-treasures, FDN Involuntary Employment's), one token.
# Static: M21 Pack Leader's verified "Other Dogs you control get +1/+1." (B4-modify-pt-other-dogs)
# with Pirate. The compiled keywords (the Treasure marker, as on Gadrak) are kept.
treasure = TokenSpec(
    name='Treasure',
    type_line='Artifact',
    types=('Artifact',),
    subtypes=(),
    power=None,
    toughness=None,
    keywords=(Keyword.TREASURE,),
    abilities=(
        ActivatedAbility(
            cost=Cost(
                parts=(
                    CostSacrifice(
                        target=Selector(
                            count=QConst(value=1),
                            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                        ),
                    ),
                    CostTap(),
                ),
            ),
            effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {
                'amount': QConst(value=1),
                'color': 'ANY',
                'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {'count': QConst(value=1), 'tokens': treasure}),
)
lord = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QUnbounded(),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Pirate'),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, lord, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, create a Treasure token.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (CREATE_TOKEN one Treasure, the compiler's TokenSpec); keywords[0] the Treasure marker
abilities[1] (StaticAbility: +1/+1 to other Pirate creatures you control)

mapping.notes: The compiler's one Treasure TokenSpec (Gadrak's verified, Involuntary Employment's), one token; the anthem is Pack Leader's verified 'Other Dogs you control get +1/+1.' with Pirate. The compiled Treasure keyword is kept.
